i=s.index('if __name__')
new='''def select_cheapest(parcel):
    """Return the selected-or-unavailable entry for one parcel.

    Ties on cost are broken by the alphabetically first service name.
    """
    options = quotes(parcel)
    if not options:
        return {"id": parcel["id"], "status": "unavailable",
                "reason": f"no service covers zone '{parcel['zone']}'"}
    best = min(options, key=lambda q: (q["cost"], q["service"]))
    return {"id": parcel["id"], "status": "selected", **best}


def select_all(parcels):
    return {"parcels": [select_cheapest(p) for p in parcels]}


def write_selection(destination="build/quotes.json", source="data/parcels.csv"):
    import json
    destination = Path(destination)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(select_all(load(source)), indent=2) + "\\n")
    return destination


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json
    import sys
    if sys.argv[1:2] == ["select"]:
        print(write_selection(*sys.argv[2:3]))
    else:

cat >> tests/test_shipping.py <<'EOF'


def test_selection():
    from shipping import select_all
    parcels = select_all(load())["parcels"]
    assert [p["id"] for p in parcels] == ["P1", "P2", "P3"]
    assert parcels[0] == {"id": "P1", "status": "selected", "service": "Express", "days": 2, "cost": 13.0}
    assert parcels[1] == {"id": "P2", "status": "selected", "service": "Economy", "days": 5, "cost": 3.0}
    assert parcels[2]["status"] == "unavailable" and parcels[2]["reason"]


def test_tie_prefers_alphabetical_name():
    from shipping import select_cheapest
    parcel = {"id": "X", "weight_kg": "1", "length_cm": "1", "width_cm": "1", "height_cm": "1", "zone": "urban"}
    assert quotes(parcel)[1]["cost"] == quotes(parcel)[2]["cost"]
    assert select_cheapest({**parcel, "weight_kg": "50"})["service"] == "Express"
EOF
